verdicts.explanation: Section 3.4 lists 4.2 mS/cm for 10% Cl@4c in the sequence 0.0, 4.2, 6.1, 5.5, 4.2, 0.4 for 0/10/25/50/75/100%, computed at 300 K by NNP-MD in this work, so the origin is computational and the null secondary fields are correct.
6.1 mS/cm is the 25% Cl@4c value in the Section 3.4 sequence, and the paper gives Ea = 0.281 eV for 25% Cl@4c at low temperatures, which matches the record.
5.5 mS/cm is the 50% Cl@4c value in the Section 3.4 sequence, and the paper gives Ea = 0.292 eV for 50% Cl@4c at low temperatures, which matches the record.
4.2 mS/cm is the 75% Cl@4c value in the Section 3.4 sequence, and the paper gives Ea = 0.294 eV for 75% Cl@4c at low temperatures, which matches the record.
0.4 mS/cm is the 100% Cl@4c value in the Section 3.4 sequence, computed at 300 K by NNP-MD in this work, and no activation energy is given for this composition, so the null is correct.
